description: The king of Myrtana who, as his armies weaken against the Orks, calls together twelve talented mages to protect Khorinis's magical-Ore mine with a barrier and later must bargain with prisoners for ore.

roles_and_vocations.note: Exact title used by the English manual.

affiliations.note: The manual calls him king in the Myrtana war story.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: Mine location in the manual account.

metaphysical_laws_and_rituals.note: He calls mages to create it; its later expansion is not inferred.

canon_status: Named historical ruler directly profiled in the English manual's Story.

citations.locator: English manual, Story pp. 14–15: 'King Rhotbar chose' through Barrier/ore bargaining account
supports: Witness spelling, kingship, Myrtana war, mage summons, Khorinis mine, Barrier, and prisoner bargaining

comparison_cautions: The name is preserved exactly as 'Rhotbar' in this English witness; no cross-localization or sequel normalization is applied.
The manual gives setup only, not his later fate, full dynasty, appearance, or a player-path outcome.

description: Leader of prisoners who agree to send ore to the King in exchange for outside goods, take the old castle, kill its guards, and create the Old Camp.

roles_and_vocations.note: The manual calls the prisoners' leader Gomez.

affiliations.note: The manual attributes its creation to his group.

canon_status: Named camp founder/leader directly profiled in the English manual's Story.

citations.locator: English manual, Story p. 16: prisoners, 'Their leader was Gomez', old castle, and Old Camp
supports: Gomez name, ore-for-goods arrangement, leadership, castle takeover, and Old Camp creation

comparison_cautions: The manual does not provide a biography, species, ability set, exact rank system, later fate, or universal player relationship.
The Old Camp is an affiliation/location, never a relationship endpoint.

description: Leader of prisoners who rebel against working for the King or Gomez, travel to the free mine area, and build the New Camp sustained by hunting, stealing, and rice farming.

roles_and_vocations.note: The manual calls the other prisoners' leader Lares.

affiliations.note: The manual attributes its creation to his group.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The named destination/location in the story.

canon_status: Named camp founder/leader directly profiled in the English manual's Story.

citations.locator: English manual, Story p. 16: 'rebelled against doing anything for the King or Gomez' through 'Their leader was Lares'
supports: Lares name, rebellion, free mine, New Camp, and subsistence description

comparison_cautions: The manual supports group-level opposition, not a full personal history, later actions, or player faction outcome.
Hunting, stealing, and farming describe the camp group's subsistence, not an exhaustive personal vocation list.

description: Leader of Old Camp prisoners who report visions and strange dreams; he leads them to a swamp and creates the sect called the Brotherhood.

roles_and_vocations.note: The manual identifies him as the group's leader who creates the Brotherhood.

power_traditions.note: The group reports these; no full personal spell repertoire is stated.

affiliations.note: The sect he creates in the manual story.

cosmologies_and_realms.note: The selected dwelling place for the Brotherhood.

canon_status: Named sect founder/leader directly profiled in the English manual's Story.

supports: Y’Berion name, leader role, visions context, journey, swamp, and Brotherhood creation
